_about: C4 oversize room lists per typology ( item 3), copied verbatim from /patches/C4/rooms_<name>.json (written by the hub, pool and cascade chats, 17 Nov). Read by c4RoomList; keyed by the C4 code (SL FH CP WB HC AQ CV).

AQ.source: (read 17 Nov) via ALIAS['AQ'], GROWS_DEF and def_ref
AQ.rule: Board rooms are matched in order (case-insensitive regex on the room name; first match wins). ref = the larger of m2 and minM2 (the larger city value where they differ; refByCity gives each), times count when m2 is given and count > 1 def_ref). minM2 is the definition's minimum (a range's low end). perPersonM2, loadGroup and bathers are the definition's fields (C5 reads them first); washroom says whether the room's people count toward the public washrooms (our reading of C5's groups). A room drawn over 1.5 x ref is a flag unless grows. One occupant load drives exits, walkways and washrooms: the full count, summed per floor area, rounded up once (project decision, 16 Nov 22:00).

CP.rule: Board rooms are matched in order (case-insensitive regex on the room name; first match wins), ports of ALIAS[CP] with the reference from the typology file (larger of m2 and minM2, times count where m2 is given). refByCity (where Vancouver and Edmonton differ) is an addition: ref is the larger of the two, so a Vancouver board is read against the Edmonton figure unless C4 reads refByCity. Occupant rates follow C5: perPersonM2 null = no load of its own (lobbies, entries, decks); bathers = on the water area (not counted from the room); washroom = a washroom room; gym users 4.60 m² a person in Vancouver (VBBL Table 3.1.17.1 with equipment) and 25 users in Edmonton (Eastglen): usersEdm.
